notes.title: Devlog #6 - Rocky times but making progress!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. It’s been a while since we’ve had a public news post about Project Cappuccino 2, but we’ve finally found a small bit of breathing room to make one. The game has still been in active development but to say this past year has been terrible is an understatement.

When the Kickstarter failed to hit the goal, we retreated from marketing for a while to focus on game development. Unfortunately, we’ve hit stumble after stumble. It’s been difficult staying motivated but we continue to chip away at the project as much as possible.

Cancer Significantly Delayed Progress

During the second half of 2023, I ended up being diagnosed with testicular cancer and had to go through that ordeal. Lots of productive time was flushed down the toilet thanks to that, but I got lucky that it was caught at Stage 1 and am essentially cured of it at this point. Aside from having to follow up with regular scans and bloodwork, I can now put this behind me.

So, on to what’s been going on with the game.

Expanding Story
Chapter 1 of all routes have been implemented and players can now experience Rosaria, Mana, Yani and Charlotte’s stories. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141732/8440d75457c81c95b4cad75e212d9f3f6e651b05.png

This comes with new NPCs that make an appearance. Nefta here is Charlotte’s mother and one of the primary antagonists of the underworld plot line. Try not to be seduced by her huge personality.

Adding all characters to BJ Scene
Existing scenes are gradually getting all of the characters added to them for players to enjoy in Story or Free Play mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141732/a0a98dc0255b2a4693f32af774a368c12862245a.png
Our goal is to have NSFW scenes feature all 4 new succubi and the 4 girls from the original cast for a total of 8 characters. We've managed to streamline the process of adding a character and we were able to add 3 of them over a month or so.

Removing Rhythm Game
After receiving feedback and going through some planning, we’ve decided to remove the Rhythm game from Project Cappuccino 2. The cutscenes from it will still remain but most players in our poll were indifferent toward this feature, or flat-out disliked it. The time saved here is instead going into other aspects of the game.

Adding Missing Backgrounds and Pending Scenes
A few backgrounds are still missing but are currently in the works. We’d like to have all of the main backgrounds of Chapter 1 ready to go for the next public demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141732/59f823c49ab3574f87d9c69cb8aa055e581ced4c.png
We’re making sure to include lots of creepy lore since players seem to dig that.


New Scenes, Toys and More
The toy box has been redesigned and is no longer across the bottom of the screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141732/505b6bb033646b4f297219782854a68a33b99e54.gif
We ended up having to do this because it was previously blocking some character's boobs depending on their size and scene. Various toys have been added to the game along with this, including some nipple toys and a few collars to use on the girls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141732/54f8ff59abc8b315517e2337bbb9235af35ab7ca.png
This scene is next on our plate to get into the game and will feature Yani sex in doggy style. It may prove to be a little bit tricky since we want to give players the option of grabbing her by the horns.

Preparing New Public Demo
It’s been a long time since we had a new public demo and we’re trying to have one ready to go before Summer this year. Depending on how this new public demo performs, we’ll see if the game is ready for an Early Access release on various platforms.

If there are too many issues or feedback is negative, we’ll put the game back in the oven for a while for more content and polish.

If you’d like to follow the development of the game, feel free to join our Discord. You can also check out our Development Road Map.

Thanks for your interest and support for our games!

-Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Devlog #5 - Kickstarter / New Public Build & More!
notes.content:
Hey guys, we’ve got another Devlog ready for you, but first, we must get a few things out of the way.

Our Kickstarter campaign is finally live and kicking!

[previewyoutube=_6083h7T5G4;full][/previewyoutube]
Surprisingly, we got approved despite the NSFW content of our game. We launched it yesterday and we've been getting some amazing attention so far. But we need your help to get the word out and make it even more successful.


There are various community milestones and goals that can be achieved, check it out because your support is vital, even if it's just spreading the word!

New Public Build Now Available

Alongside this, we just released a brand new public build of our game, and it's packed with some major content and improvements that have been made over the past few months. 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/4fc610074c6532f4e2d414a4eea3cc6cb06da88a.png
One of the new features is a Mana Cow Girl NSFW scene, which shines the spotlight on our brooding goth GF. 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/eac7bc390f5dad9182a874c7d27a66c87f3ced0a.gif
There are also some backgrounds for the colosseum map that have been added with special lighting effects to go along.

Hentai Expo 2023 was a Success!

We recently had a blast at Hentai Expo, and we're so grateful for everyone who showed up to represent Project Cappuccino. It was somewhat surreal seeing our game featured on there.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/fff9456707a722ada2204da82c3df6e66806bcd0.png
The VOD of this will be available in the new couple of days but the event featured a huge mix of games. It really does seem like the Hentai Game bubble is growing exponentially.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/a31de56852924ad8da45eea4d72b6856f7ff81f3.png
As part of this event, we've created some awesome promotional wallpapers that you can download and use on your phone, tablet, or wherever you like. There’s even an animated version in the Steam Workshop for Wallpaper Engine!

We're stoked about all the progress we've made on the game so far, and we're committed to making it the best it can be. We couldn't have gotten this far without your support, and we can't wait to share more updates with you soon.

Thanks for reading! And don’t forget the Kickstarter! Helping out is as simple as joining our Discord or Retweeting this post!

-Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Devlog #4 - New Nip Toys & Hentai Expo!
notes.content:
We’re back with a new Devlog! It’s been an extremely busy time for us and there’s a lot on our plate.

Story Scenes Implemented
Some progress has been made on story cutscenes that were missing.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/0d94cfd49f17678d9c5b72ba6e2359b2ed3178c2.jpg
Mana's route will be taking her deep into a labyrinth in pursuit of her Succubus Throne merit!

Save System Coming
Requests are piling in for us to implement the save system in Project Cappuccino 2. We’re on track to roll it out within 1 or 2 updates. The main reason we didn’t implement this from the start is that it would potentially break a ton of saves as we continue to release new versions. Not to mention that we would likely lose a lot of time trying to rework the save system every time we add new mechanics or things to the game. However, we’re at a point where we can probably comfortably add it.

Wooden Horse Finalized
The wooden horse scene with Yani is pretty much done and we’ve implemented many toys along with it!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/9e9edcd3a2b57c5e1d1548a79f65ef538e57cb95.png
There’s a total of 25 new toys or so with about 20 of them being nipple based. 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/aa32b3ab350f53a21cb5b70e38a710133468d3a0.png
Some other honorable mentions include gags and the Milk Master 9000, a high-powered milking machine.

Hentai Expo
We recently caught wind of a new event that started last year where all kinds of hentai games are showcased. It’s basically the Nintendo Direct of hentai.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/f8b6c87f3f03f323ea3c57b74e82beb6aff63a7f.jpg
As of now, we’ve contacted the team that’s putting it together and are waiting to see if we end up getting accepted. More info in this will be made available as the April 16th date draws closer, we hope you’ll stay tuned!

New Public Build

The next public build will likely be released alongside the Hentai Expo event. We would like to implement a few more things before then such as the save system and we continue to be hard at work with development.

-Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Wooden Horse & More
notes.content:
January has been off to a solid start for Project Cappuccino 2. We’ve been adding new content as well as doing a few quality-of-life improvements. Today we’ll be talking about some of this stuff as well as what’s on the horizon in the next few months.

Intro Animations
The game’s intro has been animated and had some sound effects added.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/78b0d2a9783867bbfa1ddce0f3bb5871032b044f.gif

These animations help bring the character's personalities to life and offer a glimpse at how they react in certain situations.

Outfit System
Due to a bug in Unity, we had some time to work on other things while waiting for an engine patch. One of those things was the option to change characters’ dialogue portraits.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/d756a8d15c9036a3f823c436510ef6c23e721078.gif

Players can now unlock outfits for characters and change them by using the Dressing Room. The selected outfit change will be used for all conversations involving a character, and some will even alter some dialogue entirely!

We wanted to add this feature back in the first Project Cappuccino but it was beyond our skill level at the time.

Wooden Horse Scene
Earlier this month, we had Patrons vote on which NSFW scene we would add next from our pool of pending scenes. The people have spoken and selected the Wooden Horse scene.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/b0dce273bd46b7ab2ad528bc13a1f71ae1d3161b.png

The scene is still a WIP but it’s going to feature Yani first. At the moment, it’s mostly animation work that’s left to do on it. The background has some animations as well and the BDSM fans are gonna be eating well.

Upcoming Public Build
We’re aiming to release a new public build sometime between February and March. This build will feature most of the things we’re discussing, so keep an eye out for it! If you’d like to get the early builds, you can find them over on Patreon. Your support goes a long way to keeping us in development.

Thanks and have a good one!

-Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Starting off 2023 with Horny Succubi!
notes.content:
We’re back with our second public Devlog for Project Cappuccino 2. Christmas has eaten up some of our time this month but we’re doing our best to keep powering through work whenever we can.

For starters, we spent some time planning out our workload for 2023. Here is a new Road Map.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/658c807081d7124a52091b81d9f83adb765d2b58.png

Rather than cramming everything under the sun into the road map, we decided to simplify it and only highlight what people might find the most interesting. This doesn’t necessarily mean that we’ll only be adding these things in a sprint, but rather that these will be the core elements that we’ll focus on. Anything else like boring back-end systems and QOL fixes won’t be mentioned on here and you’ll find those in the usual progress logs.

This Road Map will also be updated every 3 months or so and readjusted depending on how we move through the workload.

Rhythm Fixes

The rhythm game has been massively improved!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/5594d29e6750b8e3c837d5c621ede1f73512f40d.png

Major work was done and we now have more fine-tuned control over the hit window of notes. You’ll find that it’s much easier to actually hit them as there is a bit of lead room now as opposed to requiring perfect timing.

https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/cI6br0tP0vIicvnBUnPxtmqb0AWZh_uHkcpZf7NeW6cm7W3MWiDXjImT1_Oo-fpyBvpfKUOFs9qxixoiXob1wIEpSJOVyS-_08ibZSI8DmwlU6Htgvkd7KLKD6n90d4b07yiLbVcZDm8B2EGh28BbHFmJqJcjrfhB4vjSYXVe7U-6ZzXj6uHUc_VpfB_qQ

Some improvements have also been done to the visuals. The particles are a little more appealing now when notes are hit, and the game properly indicates when you miss a note by shaking the track and flashing red. Additionally, a small gap has been added between the note tracks to indicate which hand will play which notes.

Story Content

Yani & Charlotte’s chapter 1 is being worked on at the moment and it’s taking some intensive thought to weave the various plot threads that we have going on. Charlotte’s story will provide some background info on where Colette’s puppet curse originated, and her mother plays a vital role in the entire series. To top things off, Charlotte has the personality flip that we’ll need to take into account.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/95b2f4f7a335cd094b93fc2bd33e3fa871bebc3f.png
Yani's on the other hand is chaos to the max, as she only knows how to act like an animal.

The game’s intro sequences are almost finished and we’re only missing 2 CGs that Doku is currently working on.

https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/82bj4wQ1bN6LcAWrVFnfRbAFE4mtlo7yqf7ngZhmwz7E9z47TEKTqhsbm6F-POaDeR6v3wGuFkJXSJKuqKkCDLYufIU9yl4CSYpvo1H9R55wJd6eXwnqBYKKrhnnhjZaWtVtCECZZkjFQ-TTolmw1xoJORe1eSmRu1v_eyjAPLeaXHiq8XxkZ0dC87-QAQ
Each character is receiving a small section where it’s shown how they received their invitation to the Succubus Throne tournament. In Yani's case, it shows how she got out of her prison.

Conversation History

A small QOL update was done that we were going to need to do eventually.

https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/qm9BUwp9Hf1IlhsqNPj2oG2RzGhU6d5u_jixD8lPo8rCCSHRd69At54FhAFyGlmuTgojLJ2rCjPctGPBJ3Caf3Bb83Ljg-B0ujnVPnce2cdCWHxrHzByZx46HSzn73f42wbXkSEyxNlJSr8up4C-2NsQFuexMV1Uw374xLgZnV5FQVpphTwkIm7zrHk87A
Players can now check what NPCs said to them and toggle the conversation history whenever they want.

That’s all we’ve got for now. Keep an eye out for our next public Devlog because we’ll likely be working on something pretty raunchy soon.

-Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Project Cappuccino 2 & What's coming next?
notes.content:
Now that Project Cappuccino 2 has an official public build, our development cycle will be a bit more steady.

For the development of Project Cappuccino 2, we decided to break our work up into seasonal sprints. During these sprints, we try and complete as much work as possible. Anything that ends up not getting done gets pushed to the next season, and so on. Here’s what’s currently on our to-do list for the remaining month or so of Fall. We might try and see if we can get a public demo here on Steam and we'll let you guys know if we do.

Chapter Title Cards
This is a small polish thing but it serves to make the game feel a little more professional.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/6e6b622dc0e4dd076d78954a9a57d3154960a8a5.png
These cards will show up at the beginning of a character’s story chapters, with each one being themed around the character.

Inventory & Gifting System
Part of Yani’s route required us to give the player an item. We figured that it would be a good idea to migrate an existing inventory and gifting system from our cancelled Crystal Road project. The work was done in a matter of about 2 or 3 days and players can now gift the succubi items.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/8700f48ffbd61868ded68a680e19436ab84bc25f.png
Some key items can be “gifted” and still retained in the inventory to trigger unique dialogue.

Rhythm Game Improvements
The biggest piece of feedback that we continue to receive on the public build is that the Rhythm game is a little jank. We’re going to be fixing this ASAP but ASAP may be harder than it sounds.

The rhythm game is built upon an existing asset as opposed to having made it from scratch. This means that we’re going to need to rework the way that notes are detected since they currently work using Unity’s rhythm timeline. 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/d45bd42b2ea2898ee0ac3f566342558926e6e213.png
Being linked to this timeline means that it’s not a matter of simply expanding the hit window, as the notes are detected as “Active” to hit when they play across the timeline as opposed to using a collider. It’s not going to be impossible to fix but it’s definitely going to eat up some time.

Story CGs + Game Intro
Doku is currently working on getting some story scenes drawn. Some of these will be part of the game’s introduction which shows how the succubi ended up participating in the tournament.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43141732/8b4773b2aab0880fade0ff9f23451e306cbb91a5.png
Here we have Charlotte reading her invitation letter.

That’s all we have for this month. The next log will likely feature an updated Roadmap for 2023, so keep an eye out for that!

As for public builds of the game, those can now be expected every 3 to 4 months, with our next one being scheduled for Spring 2023.

If you want to see more content, you can follow us on Twitter(At least while it's still up lmao)

-Vanis & Doku
